page.layout: One page of text, with two marginal notes in the right margin, beside Canon 2 and Canon 3. The catchword "Ex-" stands at the foot, right.

main_text.p: Quicunq; hanc calamitatem eva-serant Gothi in altissimos ac inaccef-sos montes Asturiæ, Cantabriæ & Pyrenæorum se receperunt, & inde excursionibus in plana ac circumja-centia factis, aliquot oppida à Mau-ris recuperarunt, novosq; sibi Reges præfecerunt.
Primum regnum erectum1. in Asturia. fuit in Asturia.

A. C. 716. Primus Rex fuit Pelagius ex veterum Regum Gothorum sanguine. Sedes Regia fuit initio urbs Ovetum, deinde Legio. Unde hodieqve regnum Legionis inter titulos Regis Hispaniæ primum locum obtinet.
Secundum regnum conditum in montibus Pyrenæis.2. in montibus Pyrenæis.

page.notes: The page number "59" and the running head are printed in the top margin. Faint mirrored text at the right edge is show-through and was left out. Marginal note "1. in Asturia" is set in small type beside Canon 2, and "2. in montibus Pyrenæis" beside Canon 3. The hyphenated words "eva-serant", "inaccef-sos", "circumja-centia", "Mau-ris" and "con-ditum" were copied from their line-end breaks; the reading of "inaccef-sos" is doubtful and may be "inacces-sos" in the original. The catchword "Ex-" is printed at the foot right.
